rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He uses 96:15–16 to illustrate the second definite “ناصية” as appositional to “الناصية,” with “كاذبة خاطئة” describing it.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A nominative element that is not an adjective in an indefinite construction remains nominative in the definite; he cites “سواء محياهم ومماتهم” as an example.
